toast.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
toast.pushEnabled: Push notifications enabled on this device.
toast.pushBlocked: Notifications blocked. Unblock them from the browser padlock icon, then retry.
toast.saveFailed: Failed to save doubt management settings
toast.duplicateType: Duplicate query type key "{{key}}". Rename one of them.
toast.duplicateStatus: Duplicate status key "{{key}}". Rename one of them.

defaultAssignment.title: Default auto-assignment
defaultAssignment.description: Controls who gets pre-assigned when a learner raises a new doubt. Only affects new doubts — existing doubts keep their current assignees.

subjectTeacher.title: Subject teacher
subjectTeacher.description: Auto-assign to faculty mapped to the doubt's subject (narrowest match). Ideal for slide-level doubts where the subject is unambiguous.

batchTeacher.title: Batch teacher
batchTeacher.description: Auto-assign to every faculty mapped to the batch, regardless of subject. This is the legacy behavior.

both.title: Both
both.description: Union of subject-mapped and batch-mapped faculty.

none.title: Admins only
none.description: Skip teachers entirely — assign every doubt to your institute admins, who are notified and then triage it onward.

fallback.title: Fallback behavior
fallback.description: What to do when a doubt's subject has no mapped faculty.
fallback.label: Fall back to batch teachers when no subject teacher exists
fallback.hint: If off, doubts with no subject-mapped faculty will be left unassigned and require manual attention.

subOrg.title: {{label}} routing
subOrg.description: Applies only to doubts raised by a learner who belongs to a {{labelLower}}. Their {{labelLower}} shares this institute's courses and batches, so none of the rules above can reach its staff — batch-teacher matching skips {{labelLower}} access rows and role lookups run against this institute. Turn this on to notify them as well.
subOrg.notifyHint: They are added as assignees on top of whoever the rules above picked, so they get the email, push and bell alert and the doubt shows up in their inbox.

allTeam.title: {{label}} admins and team
allTeam.description: Everyone with active access to the learner's {{labelLower}} — its admins plus every team member added under it.

adminsOnly.title: {{label}} admins only
adminsOnly.description: Just the admins of the learner's {{labelLower}}. Quieter, but team members won't see the doubt unless an admin assigns it.

subOrg.notifyParentLabel: Also email this institute's own team
subOrg.notifyParentOn: On: your teachers/admins are notified alongside the {{labelLower}}, exactly as they are for a normal doubt.
subOrg.notifyParentOff: Off: only the {{labelLower}} is emailed. Your own team gets no email, push or bell for these doubts — but they still appear in your Doubt Management inbox, so nothing is hidden.

browserPush.title: Push notifications on this device
browserPush.description: Each admin/teacher enables push on their own browser. Without this step, the push toggles below do nothing for this user — the backend sends, the browser silently drops.

hint.granted: This device will receive FCM pushes for doubt events.
hint.denied: Click the padlock icon in the URL bar → Notifications → Allow, then reload.
hint.default: Click the button to prompt for notification permission.
hint.unsupported: Your browser doesn't expose the Notification API.

raised.title: When a doubt is raised
raised.description: Notifies the assigned teacher(s). Push is delivered via the same FCM pipeline already used elsewhere — browsers that haven't granted notification permission will silently skip.

resolved.title: When a doubt is resolved
resolved.description: Notifies the learner who raised the doubt.

push.label: Push notification
push.hint: Default on. Uses FCM — recipients must have granted notification permission and registered a device token.

bell.label: In-app bell alert
bell.hint: Default on. Shows a persistent entry in the recipient's bell icon — stays visible when the user returns to the app even if they missed the push.

email.label: Email notification
email.hint: On by default. Sent alongside the push — turn off to suppress. Uses the seeded default template unless you pick a custom one below.

emailTemplate.label: Email template
emailTemplate.helpSuffix: to use the seeded institute template — it automatically picks up your institute theme color, name, and support email. Pick a custom template here only if you want different copy.

queryTypes.title: Query types
queryTypes.description: The categories a learner can pick when raising a query (e.g. Doubt, Technical Issue, Payment Issue). Each type routes to its own default handler — including the built-in Doubt type, which you can point at a teacher, a role, or specific staff. The Doubt type can't be renamed or removed.
queryTypes.systemRoutingNote: This only changes who is auto-assigned and notified. Teacher inbox visibility still follows "Default auto-assignment" above.
queryTypes.noStaff: No active staff found. Add team members under Teams first, then pick them here.
queryTypes.nobodyPicked: Nobody picked yet — until you add someone, these queries fall back to the institute's admins.
queryTypes.alsoAssignHint: Added on top of "Route to" — pick a teacher route and still keep these people on every query of this type.

learnerQuery.title: Learner query intake
learnerQuery.description: Let learners raise queries from outside a course. Off by default — turning this on does not affect the in-course doubt flow. Learners only see the types you marked "Learner can pick" above.
learnerQuery.enableHint: Master switch for the entry points below.
learnerQuery.topbarLabel: Show "?" icon in the top bar
learnerQuery.topbarHint: A quick-access question-mark button visible across the learner app.
learnerQuery.dashboardLabel: Show "Raise a query" card on the dashboard
learnerQuery.dashboardHint: A help card on the learner home screen.
learnerQuery.guestLabel: Allow logged-out visitors to raise queries
learnerQuery.guestHint: Adds a "Need help?" button to the learner login page. Visitors leave their name and email — staff replies are emailed to that address.

statuses.title: Doubt statuses
statuses.description: The stages a doubt moves through on the staff side — Pending and Resolved are built in; add your own (In progress, Waiting on learner, Escalated…). Every status change and remark is recorded in the doubt's activity trail with who made it.

kindHint.OPEN: Learners see this as an open, unanswered doubt.
kindHint.IN_PROGRESS: Learners see this as being worked on. The doubt stays open.
kindHint.RESOLVED: Moving here resolves the doubt: the learner is notified and it leaves the pending lists.

statuses.trailNote: Internal remarks and the assignment/status history are only ever shown to admins and teachers — learners see just the status label above.
